name: Organic Maps
hook: Fast, detailed, privacy-respecting offline navigation for driving, cycling, and hiking powered by OpenStreetMap — zero battery drain, zero ads, no tracking.
bullets: 100% offline turn-by-turn navigation with voice guidance
Cycling routes, hiking trails, walking contours, and elevation profiles
Privacy-first: no location tracking, no analytics, no background telemetry
Crowd-sourced OpenStreetMap data updated continuously by the community
benefits: Navigate abroad or deep in the backcountry without cellular reception or data roaming
Saves battery life compared to proprietary maps loaded with tracking daemons
Find hidden hiking trails, water points, and bicycle lanes missing from Google Maps
OpenStreetMap search works instantly offline with bookmarks and KML/KMZ/GPX import
setupSteps: Install Organic Maps from F-Droid, Google Play, or the App Store
Download your home country, state, or region's map pack while on Wi-Fi
Search for destinations, addresses, or points of interest offline
Mount your phone and start turn-by-turn driving, cycling, or walking navigation
details: Organic Maps is an open-source, privacy-focused offline maps and GPS navigation app for Android and iOS, built on top of crowd-sourced OpenStreetMap data. Unlike Google Maps or Apple Maps, Organic Maps does not track your movements, log your search history, or profile your daily commute for advertising. You download maps for entire states or nations in advance, giving you lightning-fast offline search, turn-by-turn voice navigation, contour lines, hiking trails, and elevation profiles whether you are in an underground subway, abroad without a roaming SIM, or deep in a national park without cell service. It supports Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for in-dash driving, loads in milliseconds, and sips battery because it has no background trackers.
setup: App (Android, iOS) — install from F-Droid, Google Play, or App Store
